premises: Q is a normalized empirical TRAIN distribution over complete written forms.
For each w, alpha(s|w) is nonnegative and sums to one.
Both the source-class prior and free within-class renderer are derived from the SAME joint J(s,w)=Q(w)*alpha(s|w).
proof: For pi(s)>0, R(w|s)=J(s,w)/pi(s). Classes with pi(s)=0 contribute zero.
special_cases: The identity holds separately in each consistently conditioned cell; alternate manuscript readings remain separate.
TRAIN-unseen forms have zero mass in this empirical construction.
Smoothing one joint first and refactorizing reproduces that smoothed joint marginal; separately smoothing the factors is a different model.
limits: A fixed independent source prior, constrained shared renderer, or productive rule for unseen forms can break the premises; neither predictive improvement nor correct decipherment follows automatically.
This is not a prohibition on statistical cryptanalysis, contextual evidence, or the optional writers themselves.
No assignment of word meaning, no new native count, no scientific novelty claim.
selection_decision: Do not implement free variant pooling as a new discriminator. A future candidate must state the independently constrained source or writing-choice rule and its new falsifier first.
review: Root and bounded producer independently checked the algebra. Producer used only bounded registry cards and the named dossier section; no new payload access in this task.
